ext_description.message: Save the paper you are reading to your own BiblioFlow server.

popup_not_configured.message: Set your BiblioFlow URL and API token first.

popup_nothing_found.message: No paper was found on this page.

result_matched.message: Matched a paper already in your library and attached the PDF.

result_exists.message: This paper is already in your library.

result_no_pdf.message: The PDF could not be fetched ($1).

pdf_reason_no_pdf.message: no PDF link on the page

pdf_reason_forbidden.message: the site refused access, for example no subscription

pdf_reason_not_pdf.message: the response was not a PDF

err_bad_token.message: The API token was rejected. Check it or create a new one.

err_forbidden.message: The token is missing a scope (it needs read:papers and write:papers) or you may not write to this workspace.

err_access_login.message: The server answered with a login page. Sign in to Cloudflare Access in this browser, or add a service token in the settings.

err_network.message: Could not reach the server. Check the URL and your connection.

err_too_large.message: The server refused the file as too large.

err_rate_limited.message: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.

err_invalid.message: The server did not accept this request, or the URL is not valid.

err_not_configured.message: Set your BiblioFlow URL and API token first.

err_nothing_found.message: No paper was found on this page.

opt_pat_help.message: Create it in BiblioFlow under Settings with the scopes read:papers and write:papers. It is stored only in this browser profile.

opt_access_help.message: Not needed if you are signed in to Cloudflare Access in this browser. The browser's Access cookie is sent automatically.

opt_permission_denied.message: Permission to contact this server was not granted.

opt_token_needed.message: Enter the API token for this server (a stored token is only used for the URL it was saved with).
